application.name: @gftdcojp/spirit-in-physics
application.description: Jung's Word Association Test Embedding Model for quantifying the human spirit.

processes.name: Consent Process
processes.description: Handles user consent for research participation before the test begins.
steps: Display consent form and demographic questions.

processes.name: Jung's Voice Association Test
processes.description: Core process where the user performs the word association test via voice.
steps: A stimulus word is presented visually and audibly.
User responds by speaking the first associated word that comes to mind.
Hume AI API captures and transcribes the user's voice.
Response and reaction time are recorded in the zustand store.
Process repeats for the configured number of words.

processes.name: Kawasaki Model Visualization
processes.description: Displays the 3D force graph representation of the Kawasaki Model.

components.name: PageClient
components.description: Main client-side component that orchestrates the overall page layout and flow.

components.name: ResearchParticipationConsent
components.description: UI component for capturing user consent and demographic information.

components.name: SpiritInPhysicsInteractive
components.description: Wrapper component that contains the main interactive voice assessment.

components.name: JungVoiceAssessment
components.description: Manages the setup and state for the voice test, delegating to JungVoiceTest.

components.name: JungVoiceTest
components.description: Handles the core logic of the voice test: presenting words, playing audio, capturing voice input via Hume API, and recording responses.

components.name: KawasakiModel
components.description: Renders the 3D visualization of the physics model.

components.name: kawasakiStore
components.description: Zustand store for global state management, including test results and real-time test state.

steps.action: User clicks 'Start Test', triggering `startTest` action in zustand store.
Detects `currentWordIndex` change, plays audio for the stimulus word.
User clicks 'Respond', `startListening` is called, connecting to Hume API.
Transcribes user's voice and sends back the text.
Receives transcription, calls `recordResponse` action in zustand store.
Adds response to `userResponses`, increments `currentWordIndex`. If test is over, calls `completeTest`.
(On complete) Calculates results and saves them to `voiceAssessments` in persistent storage.
